definition: A training objective where the model predicts several future tokens at each position instead of one, densifying the learning signal and enabling faster speculative-style decoding (used in DeepSeek-V3).
details: A training objective where the model predicts several future tokens at each position instead of one, densifying the learning signal and enabling faster speculative-style decoding (used in DeepSeek-V3).

explainer.lead: Multi-token prediction trains the model to predict several future tokens at each position instead of one, densifying the learning signal. It also enables faster speculative-style decoding and is used in DeepSeek-V3.

tiers.eli5: Instead of guessing only the next word, you guess the next few words at once, giving yourself more practice per step.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers add extra prediction heads for future tokens to strengthen training and speed up decoding. A pitfall is the added compute and complexity of managing multiple predictions.
tiers.paperLevel: At each position the model predicts several future tokens rather than a single next token, densifying the learning signal and enabling speculative-style decoding.

explainer.example: At each position the model outputs predictions for the next few tokens, and those extra predictions support faster speculative-style decoding.
